The '''Darellian fire crab''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Crustacean/Legends|crustacean]]<ref name="AOTC novel" /> hailing from the [[Darellia system/Legends|Darellia system]]<ref name="Planetnamia" /> in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TEA date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of {{Film|II}} in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] blushed like a Darellian [[Fire/Legends|fire]] [[Crab/Legends|crab]] when the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] asked him to assume her [[Senator/Legends|senatorial]] duties during her upcoming absence. Binks bowed as if to cover up his blushing.<ref name="AOTC novel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darellian fire crabs were mentioned in [[R. A. Salvatore]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC novel" /> The novel was published on [[April 23]], [[2002]],<ref name="RandomHouse">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=26771|text=R.A. Salvatore}}</ref> prior to the film's premiere on [[May 16]] of the same year.<ref name="Year1">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref>
